sources.title: RikkaBotan/NexteraBERT-Mezzoforte-220M-en · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: NexteraBERT is a fast, long-context bidirectional encoder. This repository holds the main model of the NexteraBERT paper: an English model with 212.6M parameters, pretrained with masked language modeling (MLM) on 130B tokens.
